title: Our Family Home
text:
This is my family. My father is a teacher, and my mother is a nurse. We live in a small house with a big garden.

Every morning, my mother makes breakfast for us. My sister and I help her clean the table. In the evening, we watch TV together.

questions.text: What is the narrator's father's job?
Why do the family members probably spend time together in the evening?
options: They are angry with each other.
They do not have a television.
They have no house to live in.

questions.text: What kind of family does the passage describe?
options: A family that shares work and spends time together
A family that lives far away from each other
A family that never eats together

vocabulary.definition: a piece of land where plants and flowers are grown
the first meal of the day, eaten in the morning
with another person or other people
a person whose job is to care for sick or injured people

paragraph_translations: Bu benim ailem. Babam öğretmen, annem ise hemşire. Küçük bir evde yaşıyoruz ve büyük bir bahçemiz var.
Her sabah annem bize kahvaltı hazırlar. Kız kardeşim ve ben ona masayı temizlemesinde yardım ederiz. Akşamları birlikte televizyon izleriz.
